description:
Ask one person, by id, to apply to your open bounty.
Use for: a poster who already knows which person they want. Inviting the same person to the same bounty again sends nothing new.
Not for: telling many matching workers at once (invite_more_applicants); finding the person’s id (list_humans); seeing whether they applied (list_applications).
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: invite_human({"bountyId":"b7Kq2mXw9TzR4nLp","humanId":"h2Lw9QxT4mZp7Rk"})
Repeat: A repeat with the same input, and the same key if you sent one, does not act twice: it returns the same result, finishes the first call, or is refused.
Errors: not_found, not_open, worker_unavailable, already_applied; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

bountyId.description: The bounty id, or a pasted rentahuman.ai/bounties/... link.

humanId.description: The human id, as `id` in list_humans.

name: invite_human

invitedAt.description: When they were first invited to this bounty. A repeat answers the first time.

isEmailSent.description: True only when the email about this invitation is confirmed sent. Left out when it is not confirmed: they turned off bounty email, the email could not be sent, or its delivery was not recorded. The invitation is stored either way.

isRepeat.description: True when they were already invited to this bounty. Nothing new was stored or sent.

title: Invite a human
